h2. Description

*When a single type is selected and nothing matches, the message does not say which type it
searched* - it is word-for-word the same as the message shown across all types.

For example, with *Vendors* selected the box reads *No results for "S1- 56438"*, exactly as it does
with no type selected. The reader cannot tell whether nothing matched anywhere, or only nothing
matched in Vendors, and so cannot tell whether widening the search would help.

This appears inconsistent with the expected *no-results state* defined in *Epic SV-9160* and
*Global Search - Product Requirements v1.5*.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to ShopView and open *Global Search* using the Search control in the top-right corner, or press *Ctrl + K*.
# Search for {{S1- 56438}}, which matches nothing, and read the message:
#* It reads *No results for "S1- 56438"* - correct, because no type is selected.
# Search for {{Fib}}, select the *Vendors* tab, then search for {{S1- 56438}} again:
#* The message is unchanged - *No results for "S1- 56438"* - with no mention of Vendors.

*Actual Result:*
The message is identical whether a type is selected or not, and never names the selected type.
The same was seen with Customers and with Parts selected.

*Expected Result:*
With a single type selected, the message names it - for example *No results for "S1- 56438" in
Vendors*.

h2. Screenshots

!no-results.png|width=684!

_The same search, first across all types and then with only Vendors selected._

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch [https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com|https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com/]
(build {{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. No data is
needed - {{S1- 56438}} matches nothing on the branch.

h2. Sources

{quote}The centred message reads 'No results for "<query>" in <Tab>' - the active scope tab's name
is appended after ' in '.{quote}

Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5 - Confluence page 576978945.
